patch_description: Introduce a base parameter for RY rotations per group (corner/edge/center) and add per-upload delta parameters (three uploads). This increases expressivity without a large depth increase by allowing small, upload-specific adjustments to the shared RY rotations. Implemented by replacing the single shared ry_corner/ry_edge/ry_center entries with base keys and adding delta keys for uploads 0..2. Updated apply_ansatz_block to compute angles as base + delta for delta-parameter entries, while base entries remain as before. This should improve validation/test performance by enabling slight per-upload modulation of the RY layers, leveraging parameter sharing for efficiency.
